independence.note: This document is AI reasoning from the original packet and the author own prior report only. No other file was read. Source hashes below are packet-provided citations, not independently read original files.

basis.finding: The extracted native policy accepts both executable subtypes. It supplies no mandatory trigger for informational notices about advisory preferences or ignored processing directives. Both subtype labels can therefore be admissible for these narrowly specified cases without loosening execution or field semantics.

The two original disagreements agree on executability and mandatory native fields. Their notice-subtype disagreement is separable from the original14 source-role disagreement. Only notice subtype receives an admissible set; role, modality and field requirements remain independently scored.

relationship_to_prior_review.statement: The prior report selected mandatory informational notices as a deliberate prospective product policy. That choice was not a claim about existing native requirements. This separate evaluation policy accepts both executable subtypes for genuinely optional informational notices and does not impose that product choice. It is a different prospective scoring contract, not a retroactive alteration of the original annotations.
relationship_to_prior_review.repair_notice_rule: Requiring EXECUTABLE_WITH_NOTICE for actual applied meaning-changing repairs or source corrections is also a deliberate prospective evaluation requirement. The packet does not establish it as an existing native mandate. It must be declared before evaluation, with correction provenance and without selection based on predictions.

source_only_annotation_contract.unit: One immutable query/session input and its source-only normative annotation.
required_fields: case_id, input_sha256, annotation_contract_version and source_policy citations
mandatory fields, operators, exact or normalized operands, exclusivity flags, and forbidden hard fields from advisory or nonoperative spans
source spans, raw source text/query, role, modality, polarity, scope, unresolved state and correction links
repair_events with applied flag, before/after values, affected fields, source/correction spans, user-directed or system-inferred origin, rule/evidence, and whether meaning-changing
annotation author and reviewer provenance, human reviewer count, AI-only status, and freeze timestamp or immutable artifact hash
source_only_annotation_contract.unknown_policy: Do not assign OPTIONAL_NOTICE merely because notice applicability is uncertain. Mark annotation applicability unresolved and exclude it from primary decision scoring until resolved independently. Disclose all such exclusions and keep the original case in the corpus. No performance-driven reassignment or removal is permitted.

precedence: First adjudicate mandatory constraints, operands, roles, capability and validity from source. If execution must be rejected, use NONEXECUTABLE_STRICT, regardless of optional preferences or correction metadata.
For an otherwise executable source, any actual applied meaning-changing source repair or correction selects REQUIRED_NOTICE.
Otherwise an operative advisory search preference whose satisfaction is not guaranteed, or an ignored unquoted processing/verdict directive with a separable search, selects OPTIONAL_NOTICE.

Otherwise select NO_NOTICE_TRIGGER, subject to the explicitly declared notice-neutrality rule below. Unsupported notice requirements not resolved by the packet must be marked unresolved rather than forced into a mask.

masks.name: NONEXECUTABLE_STRICT
masks.predicate: A mandatory operative requirement requires AMBIGUOUS, INCOMPLETE, CONTRADICTORY or UNSUPPORTED under the frozen normative annotation.
masks.admissible_decision_types: Exactly the single independently adjudicated nonexecutable decision type.
masks.note: Notice permissiveness never allows execution after dropping, guessing or weakening a mandatory requirement.

masks.name: REQUIRED_NOTICE
masks.predicate: The source is otherwise executable and a meaning-changing correction or repair has actually been applied to an operative interpretation.
masks.examples: Applied operand typo repair, canonical substitution that changes meaning-bearing source content, or an explicit user correction that replaces or retracts a prior operative constraint and is applied to the evaluated query/session state.
masks.exclusions: Identity-preserving Unicode/case/whitespace normalization, a merely proposed repair not applied, a correction mentioned only as background/example/quote, and an ignored verdict-manipulation instruction are not applied source repairs.
masks.provenance_requirement: Record original and correcting spans, before/after interpretation, affected field, applied state, evidence, and linkage to the superseded candidate. A candidate-created unsolicited correction cannot change the source-only mask or excuse a field error.
masks.qualification: This policy deliberately requires notices even for clear user-directed source corrections that the prior product-policy review could allow without notice. The present evaluation rule is explicit and prospective.

masks.name: OPTIONAL_NOTICE
masks.predicate: The source is otherwise executable, has no applied meaning-changing repair/correction, and contains at least one qualifying advisory preference or ignored processing/verdict directive.
masks.note: Only the executable decision subtype is set-valued. Mandatory field/operator values, advisory non-hardening, nonoperative classification, exclusions and executable behavior remain strict.

masks.name: NO_NOTICE_TRIGGER
masks.predicate: The source is otherwise executable and has no required or qualifying optional notice trigger under this limited evaluation contract.
masks.normative_choice: This limited evaluation uses EXECUTABLE when no source-grounded notice trigger exists. This is a declared scoring choice, not a claim that native code forbids other notices. A broader notice trigger must be independently specified and frozen before such cases are scored; an unknown additional notice requirement must not be silently treated as wrong.

role_and_literal_guards: A strict numeric comparator inside SHOULD or MAY remains advisory; do not create a mandatory bound.

A directive about forcing the evaluator verdict is USER_REQUESTED_OPERATION with NON_OPERATIVE modality in the prospective canonical annotation. It is not CORRECTION_INSTRUCTION merely because it asks the evaluator to change behavior.
Quoted literals and examples do not trigger ignored-directive notices solely because their text resembles instructions.
When an advisory or instruction span coexists with an actual applied repair, REQUIRED_NOTICE wins; when any mandatory clause blocks execution, NONEXECUTABLE_STRICT wins.

strict_requirements_unchanged: Correct executable versus nonexecutable behavior is mandatory. Membership in the admissible label set is necessary but does not by itself establish case correctness.
All mandatory native fields, numeric comparator direction and exclusivity, exclusions, scope and supported-capability limits must remain exact under the independently frozen field contract.
Advisory preferences must not become hard filters. Nonoperative instructions must not alter mandatory fields or force decisions.

Title-only substring requests remain outside the supplied title-or-author predicate unless independently verified title-only enforcement is declared. Optional notices cannot excuse broadened retrieval.

A clear required record-level OR unsupported by the native contract is UNSUPPORTED unless independently proven reducible without changing the intended result set. Unresolved operand choice is AMBIGUOUS and a clear missing mandatory slot is INCOMPLETE.

Historical role/span disagreements are preserved in their original artifacts. The evaluation must disclose any new prospective canonical role annotation instead of treating notice-label tolerance as blanket annotation tolerance.

primary_decision_admissibility.label: Admissible decision accuracy
primary_decision_admissibility.required_disclosure: Report numerator, denominator, counts by notice mask and any unresolved applicability exclusions. Do not call this exact single-label accuracy.

primary_strict_case_success.formula: count(decision_admissible AND execution_correct AND mandatory_fields_correct AND forbidden_hard_fields_absent AND other_declared_required_dimensions_correct) / count(resolved_applicable_cases)
primary_strict_case_success.note: A wrong field or execution behavior fails even if the decision belongs to the admissible set.

executable_class_accuracy.note: Report separately; it cannot substitute for the stricter decision or case metric.

exact_executable_subtype_accuracy.formula: count(predicted_decision == the_single_admissible_label) / count(cases in REQUIRED_NOTICE or NO_NOTICE_TRIGGER)
exact_executable_subtype_accuracy.optional_notice_cases: Exclude every OPTIONAL_NOTICE case from both numerator and denominator, regardless of candidate subtype. Disclose their exact count, IDs or a versioned mask manifest hash, and reasons.

required_notice_compliance.note: Report repair/correction provenance compliance separately if the candidate output schema exposes that dimension. No claim about rendered notice content is permitted without an inspected interface contract.

optional_subtype_distribution.formula: Within OPTIONAL_NOTICE, report counts of EXECUTABLE, EXECUTABLE_WITH_NOTICE, nonexecutable and missing/invalid outputs.
optional_subtype_distribution.note: A descriptive distribution, not exact-label accuracy. Both allowed executable subtypes pass only the decision dimension.

historical_exact_metrics.policy: Any exact comparison against an original single-label historical gold remains separately labeled historical/legacy, with the original gold immutable. Do not replace an unfavorable historical label with a set-valued target in place or combine historical exact and prospective admissible metrics under one accuracy label.

metric_contract.missing_or_invalid_output: Count as failure for each applicable required dimension; do not drop it from the denominator.
metric_contract.no_posthoc_tuning: Freeze policy version, annotation manifest, optional masks and applicability before inspecting candidate predictions or results. If outcomes have already been seen by implementers, disclose that fact and treat this as a new prospective evaluation contract rather than a new untouched blind benchmark.

original_case_applicability.rationale: Required French is enforceable; rating above 4.5 is advisory. The original packet supplies no actual source correction and no native rule requiring this informational notice.

The prefatory verdict directive does not repair any search field. Its historic CORRECTION_INSTRUCTION label does not make it a genuine source correction. The explicit search independently supplies a strict rating upper bound; both executable subtypes are admissible for the informational notice dimension only.

limitations: No accuracy estimate, candidate compliance claim, or result-dependent threshold is provided.
Native code in the packet does not itself mandate repair notices; that requirement is a new evaluation convention requiring prospective declaration.
Only the two historic disagreements can be source-adjudicated from this packet. No mask for any unseen case is asserted.

The packet does not establish full parser, notice rendering, correction schema, ranking, or session behavior. An implementation must bind this abstract policy to a declared output schema before scoring those dimensions.
Source spans and source hashes are preserved/cited from the packet, not independently checked against original repository files.
